Hi Priya — nice to meet you. I’m Olga from the implementation team and I’ll run the tenant provisioning work. Thanks Monica for the handoff. 

Planned steps & timeline: 
1) Today: I will create the peregrine-prod project, add the three role templates (Admin, Integrator, ReadOnly), and prepare a seeded admin API key for the implementation sprint.
2) Tomorrow morning: I’ll send the email invites to the addresses listed in the kickoff slide and include next-step instructions (how to accept invites, brief SSO notes).
3) Day 3 (if needed): We can enable KMS-backed key storage and configure automatic rotation. I need your preference on rotation cadence (30 / 90 / 180 days) and whether you require HSM/KMS integration now.

A couple of questions to help me scope: 
- Do you want the seeded admin key to be valid for 7 days (default) or a shorter window? We can issue it as a one-time-use developer key and then rotate to a service account key.
- For the two engineers listed in the slides, should they be Integrator or Admin? We typically recommend Integrator for deploy teams and Admin only for a small set of users.

I’ve attached a short checklist and will follow up with the actual invite emails once the tenant exists.

Attachments: peregrine_kickoff_slides.pdf (referenced)
